label: Core benchmark v2
notes: Re-minted from core-v1 for the 2026-08-17 taxonomy retirement (guidance blocks stripped of retired keys). Never edited in place: changing a prompt means core-v3.json -- old manifests reference the v1 fingerprint.

items.prompt: a weathered wooden crate bound with iron
items.notes: the canonical easy case: one convex blob, clear silhouette

items.prompt: a hanging brass lantern with a glass pane
items.notes: glass and a handle: two things TRELLIS routinely fills in

items.prompt: a stack of leather-bound books
items.notes: repeated parallel slabs; tests whether the gaps survive

items.prompt: a ceramic vase with a narrow neck
items.notes: rotationally symmetric, so the hallucinated back should be nearly free

items.prompt: an anvil on a wooden block
items.notes: two materials meeting at a hard edge

items.prompt: a coiled rope with a rusted hook
items.notes: the hardest prop: thin, coiled, heavily self-occluding

items.prompt: a wooden barrel with iron hoops
items.notes: near-duplicate of the crate on purpose: a seed-stability control

items.prompt: a treasure chest with a domed lid
items.notes: one of the three mesh_profile qualification subjects (chest, sword, rock)

items.prompt: a straight longsword with a crossguard
items.notes: the second qualification subject; a flat blade is where thin geometry fails

items.prompt: a battle axe with a wide curved head
a compact energy rifle with glowing vents
items.notes: panel seams and emissive: tests whether detail survives the budget

items.prompt: a wooden bow with a taut string
items.notes: the string is sub-voxel; expected to vanish, and that is the measurement

items.prompt: a spiked war hammer with a long haft
a curved dagger with a jewelled pommel
a riot shield with a reinforced rim
items.notes: a flat plate: the degenerate case for a volumetric reconstruction

items.prompt: a gnarled wooden staff topped with a crystal
a hooded adventurer standing in a neutral pose
items.notes: the rig template's target shape

items.prompt: a plate-armoured knight standing at attention
a robed wizard holding a staff
items.notes: a held prop: tests whether the arm and staff fuse

items.prompt: a squat armoured goblin with a club
a slender android in a jumpsuit
a four-legged wolf standing alert
items.notes: no humanoid template fits; the quadruped skeleton's subject

items.prompt: a cartoon mushroom creature with stubby arms
a skeleton warrior holding a rusted sword
items.notes: genuinely holed geometry: the meshaudit stress case

items.prompt: a wooden handcart with two spoked wheels
items.notes: spokes are the thin-geometry case at vehicle scale

items.prompt: a boxy armoured personnel carrier
a single-seat racing hovercraft
a rusted pickup truck with a flat tyre
a small wooden rowboat with oars
items.notes: an open concave hull: the classic reconstruction failure

items.prompt: a steampunk airship gondola with brass fittings
a military motorcycle with saddlebags
a cargo sled on iron runners
a modular stone wall section with a doorway
items.notes: a doorway is a hole a silhouette check should find

items.prompt: a weathered stone well with a wooden roof
a gnarled dead tree with bare branches
items.notes: the worst case for a narrow-band remesh

items.prompt: a market stall with a striped awning
a mossy stone staircase
items.notes: repeated hard edges: where decimation shows first

items.prompt: a sci-fi corridor segment with panel lighting
a wooden watchtower on stilts
a large mossy boulder
items.notes: the third mesh_profile qualification subject, and the easiest item here
